Subject: Follow-up: Marketplace procurement path & PO vs Card (LumenAI)

Hi Jordan / Priya 

Thanks again for taking the call this morning  good to meet the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps on procurement/commercial path: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- You run inference-heavy workloads for LumenAI's document understanding product; predictable unit economics matter.
- Procurement is evaluating both direct billing (card / corporate card) and PO-based purchases.
- There's interest in an AWS Marketplace path to simplify procurement across business units, but you want to understand timelines and what Redwood needs to get listed.

Questions for procurement qualification
1) Preferred payment method: PO (net terms) or card? If PO, what terms (NET30, NET45)?
2) Do you want Redwood to pursue AWS Marketplace listing (or GCP/Azure)? If so, which cloud(s) should we prioritize?
3) Who is the procurement contact / billing contact we should engage for vendor onboarding and to receive the necessary vendor attestations / legal entity info?
4) Any internal compliance docs required up front (SOC2, DPA, ISO)? We have an SOC2 report and standard security pack ready.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll attach a one-page pricing sheet and an AWS marketplace onboarding checklist for your procurement team to review.
- If you want to go the AWS Marketplace + PO path, we'll loop in our marketplace programs lead (Camila) to run onboarding and split tasks: Camila for onboarding, Jonas for contract/legal.

Can you confirm: 1) preferred payment method, 2) whether we should start AWS Marketplace prep, and 3) the procurement contact email?

Thanks  happy to hop on a short follow-up with procurement if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa 

Great speaking with you as well  quick answers from procurement side: 

1) Payment method: Procurement prefers a PO on AWS Marketplace where possible. We can do direct card for small POCs but anything production-grade we need a PO and NET30 terms (standard).
2) Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is our priority  we use AWS across our infra. GCP/Azure are lower priority for now.
3) Procurement contact: Raj Patel (cc'd) is our procurement manager and will own onboarding. For billing/invoicing please send invoices to billing@lumenai.com (cc procurement@lumenai.com).
4) Compliance docs: SOC2 Type II report and DPA are needed. If you have any additional vendor questionnaires, please send them to procurement@lumenai.com.

Timeline: If we start marketplace onboarding this week, procurement estimates vendor review + listing prep ~4-6 weeks; PO issuance likely within 6 weeks after vendor approval (depends on legal review).

Raj  can you confirm the exact vendor form we need and whether LumenAI requires an LOA or any additional supplier onboarding docs?

Thanks,
